words.definition: &vi. 对……有用；上（菜、饮料） vt. 为……服务；提供；满
words.etymology: Late 12c., “to render habitual obedience to,” also “minister, give aid, give help,” from Old French servir “to do duty toward, show devotion to; set table, serve at table; offer, provide with,” from Latin servire “be a servant, be in service, be enslaved;” figuratively “be devoted; be governed by; comply with; conform; flatter,” originally “be a slave,” related to servus “slave,” which is of uncertain origin.
examples: Serve the cakes warm. 烤饼要趁热端上来
words.mnemonic: serve：give help, do duty toward, serve at table, provide with→对……有

collocations: the local bus service：当地的公交线路
words.definition: 服务；效力；交通线路；公共服务机构
examples: Mining rose by 9.1%, manufacturing by 9.4% and services by 4.3%.
words.mnemonic: serv-（服务）+ -ice（名词后缀）→服务；效力；交通线路；服务机

collocations: prepare several servings of soup：准备几份汤
words.definition: （供一个人吃的）一份食物 adj. 上菜用的
examples: Pile the potatoes into a warm serving dish.

words.definition: 服务器；侍者；（网球、羽毛球等的）发球员

in-（在……期间内）+ service（供职）→在供职期间的→在职期间进

collocations: do a disservice to the nation：对国家造成危害
words.mnemonic: dis-（使相反）+service（服务；效劳）→即服务造成伤害而不是益处

collocations: deserve a rest：该休息一下了
words.mnemonic: de-（加强语气）+serve（服务）→因热情服务而得到某项权利→to

collocations: to give money to a deserving cause：把钱捐给值得赞助的事业
examples: He was undeserving of her affections. 他不配得到她的爱。

words.definition: 服务不周到的；服务匮乏的

collocations: a dessert wine：餐末甜酒 the dessert trolley：（餐厅内）送甜点的手推
